notes: Version history: v1.0 opened from O16's original (since withdrawn) baseline and amplitude-factor claims, and asserted this paper's toy model identifies conjugate blocks with the fibres of the non-injective projection Pi 'as measured by the real pipeline,' with a proof step (labelling-independence) that was asserted rather than argued. v1.1 withdrew the pipeline identification and requalification of O14-O15, and replaced the weak proof step with a direct combinatorial proof of a stronger, unconditional result: exact block-independence for any two blocks, not only conjugate ones -- which undercuts rather than supports the withdrawn fibre claim. v1.2 (this version) rewrites the PDF body to state only the current, established content, with no narrative of what was withdrawn; the title's 'A Corrective Revision' suffix is dropped. No mathematical content changed between v1.1 and v1.2. Full history: https://github.com/Cosmochrony/spectral-o17
